answer: New identities start on a public mesa: a registry where each agent posts a 40,000 POA deposit before trading, so a plume of fresh fakes cannot hide. The deposit stays locked three epochs, released only after honest work. Vouching for a fake seizes and burns the deposit, half pays the reporter, and the identity is banned eight epochs. Forging 1,000 fakes costs 1,000 × 40,000 = 40,000,000 POA; an honest agent pays once and earns it back. One bad vouch sends a ripple through the registry, flagging its sponsored identities. The limit is cold start: honest newcomers wait three epochs to earn.
